title: 第19章 身份求追读求收藏求月票推荐票第20章 养望求追读求收藏求月票推荐票
content_zh:
【姓名：苏牧】
【身份：捕快（吏）】
【点数：80】
【武艺：伏波刀法（小成）、箭术（入门）】
…………
苏牧看着面板上的内容，心情略微有些复杂。
只是一日时间，点数就增加了整整十点。
身份只是从白身变成了吏，点数的增加速度就有了质的变化。
如果是更高的身份呢？
什么叫阶级？
这就是阶级啊！
“虽然邢兆福遵守承诺，给了我捕快的身份，但是他对我的杀心并没有消失，相反，他现在只怕更想弄死我了。”
苏牧心中沉吟道。
现在加入南城司并非他的本意，他原本想要等刀法圆满之后再展露本事，加入南城司的。
但是黑龙寨三当家的出现引起了一系列的连锁反应，导致现在他武艺未成就已经暴露在人前。
更可怕的是，他还被南城司的捕头给惦记上了。
也就是邢兆福还有所顾忌，不敢在城内明目张胆地对他下手。
但可以想象，只要让邢兆福找到机会，他定然不会放过自己。
而自己可以依靠的，就只有自己的实力和努力。
“一个月，只要一个月，我的伏波刀法就能大成，到时候，辗转腾挪的机会就更大了。

可是，他能给我一个月吗？”
苏牧心中叹息道。
咚！
咚！
咚！
就在这时，忽然门外响起了敲门声。
这么晚了，是谁？
苏牧心中疑惑，一只手握住刀柄，另外一只手则是将门拉开了一道缝。
“是你？”
透过门缝，苏牧看到门外站着一个纤细的身影，“有事？”
“有。”
刘红玉点点头，低声道，“我能进去说吗？”
苏牧犹豫了一下，不过还是拉开门，让刘红玉进了院子。
“有什么事就在这里说吧。”
苏牧在院子里停下脚步，并未将她请进屋去。
“我知道是你。”
content_en:
[Name: Su Mu]
[Identity: Detective (official)]
[Points: 80]
[Martial Arts: Fubo Sword Technique (Xiao Cheng), Archery (Beginner)]
…………
Su Mu looked at the content on the panel with a slightly complicated mood.
In just one day, the points increased by ten points.
The identity just changed from Bai Shen to official, and the rate of increase in points has changed qualitatively.
What if it is a higher status?
What is class?
This is class!
"Although Xing Zhaofu kept his promise and gave me the identity of a police agent, his murderous intention towards me has not disappeared. On the contrary, he is afraid that he wants to kill me even more now."
Su Mu thought to himself.
It was not his original intention to join the Nancheng Division now. He originally wanted to wait until he had perfected his sword skills before showing off his skills and joining the Nancheng Division.
However, the emergence of the third master of Black Dragon Village caused a series of chain reactions, and now his lack of martial arts skills has been exposed to the public.
What's even more frightening is that he is also on the radar of Nancheng Division's head catcher.
That is to say, Xing Zhaofu still had some scruples and did not dare to attack him blatantly in the city.
But it is conceivable that as long as Xing Zhaofu finds an opportunity, he will not let him go.
The only thing you can rely on is your own strength and hard work.
"One month, just one month, my Fubo Sword Technique will be perfected. By then, I will have a greater chance of moving around.
But, can he give me one month? "
Su Mu sighed in his heart.
Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
At this moment, there was a knock on the door.
It's so late, who is it?
Su Mu was confused, holding the handle of the knife with one hand, and opening the door a crack with the other hand.
"Is it you?"
Through the crack in the door, Su Mu saw a slender figure standing outside the door, "Is something wrong?"
"Yes."
Liu Hongyu nodded and whispered, "Can I go in and talk?"
Su Mu hesitated for a moment, but still opened the door and let Liu Hongyu into the yard.
"If you have anything to say, just say it here."
Su Mu stopped in the yard and did not invite her into the house.
"I know it's you."
